personality: Fusion: 1 iOS-Native Clean structure with 4 Tactile/Playful colors and interactions
personality_one_liner: A bright, trustworthy, and highly tactile Indian fintech super-app that turns every transaction into a celebratory, rewarding moment.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets (min 44x44pt). Avoid dense dashboards. Group content using iOS-native rhythm but with tactile, rounded components.

do's: Use frosted glass overlays on the Hero Wallet Balance card to make it feel premium.
Apply to sticky bottom action buttons (e.g., 'Pay Now') when content scrolls behind.
Use glassmorphic bottom navigation bars for a premium, uncluttered look.
dont's: Do not apply glassmorphism to standard list items, form inputs, or dense utility screens.
Avoid glass on low-end Android fallback (use solid surfaceSecondary instead).

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Mobile OTP login and 4-digit PIN setup.

states.error: Inline red helper text for invalid OTP/PIN.

screens.layout: Bottom-heavy layout. Welcome text and large branding at the top. The mobile number input and 'Send OTP' CTA placed securely in the lower 1/3 thumb zone. Auto-focus on input.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Primary landing showing Wallet Balance and quick access to all utility payment services.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for wallet balance and service icons.
states.error: Error state in wallet card with 'Tap to Retry'.

screens.layout: Top section features a premium glassmorphic Hero Wallet card over a brand-tinted gradient. Below the hero card is a clean, modular 4-column grid for services (Mobile, DTH, Electricity, Broadband). High-frequency actions are visually distinct. Use 'brandTertiary' tinted rounded-square containers for service icons.

screens.name: Operator/Biller Selection & Payment
screens.purpose: Select service provider, enter details, and complete payment (simulated).

states.error: Full screen error with 'Retry' CTA if bill fetch fails.

screens.layout: List view for operators using real PNG logos (e.g., Jio, Airtel). Once selected, transition to a form screen (single column, labels above inputs). The 'Pay' CTA must be sticky at the bottom, reserving space for scrolling content.

screens.name: Rewards / Scratch Card Reveal
screens.purpose: Celebratory scratch card interaction after a successful transaction.
screens.layout: Full-screen modal or sheet. The scratch card is the hero element in the center. Requires React Native Gesture Handler for the scratching motion, revealing a bright 'Sunny Yellow/Gold' prize overlay. Trigger a Lottie celebration/confetti animation upon threshold reach (progress > 70%).

screens.name: Wallet & Transaction History
screens.purpose: Ledger of all past payments, cashback credits, and 'Add Money' functionality.
screens.layout: Sticky header with current balance and 'Add Money' CTA. Below is a scrollable list of transactions. Each row uses a leading visual (brand icon or logo), title, date, and amount (green for +cashback, dark for -payment). Ensure generous 56pt height per row.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Blue and Purple are heavily banned; rely on the provided Emerald Green (brand) and Amber (rewards) to drive the fintech super-app look.
Implement the 'Cashback for sure' requirement visually on the Rewards screen. Utilize React Native Gesture Handler to build an interactive scratch card that reveals the prize.
Ensure 'brandTertiary' (#D1FAE5) is used as the background for the services grid icon containers. This gives the tactile, playful aesthetic requested by the user.
The Hero Wallet Balance card on the Home screen must utilize a premium layout, ideally an expo-linear-gradient background or a frosted glass overlay (expo-blur).
Sticky buttons at the bottom of the screen (e.g., 'Pay Now' on forms) are mandatory when there is scrollable content above them. Avoid floating input labels; keep forms simple and single-column.

Research insight: Indian fintech apps thrive on clear visual hierarchy. Use the wallet balance as the hero element and surface high-frequency actions immediately below it without burying them in menus.
